answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit and link its work to a single verified vertex in a public reputation graph before it can trade. A newcomer starts at the ridge of trust and must complete small, checked jobs over time, so reputation grows only through attested history, not by creating many accounts. Like a glacier, that history moves slowly and cannot be faked overnight. An attacker spawning thousands of identities must fund each deposit, endure slow probation, and risk losing the stake if peers detect dishonest work, making a fake army costlier than profit it could steal.
